plugin.name: Medicine Reminder
plugin.description: Your pet reminds you to take your medicine at the same times every day.
config.medicineName.label: Medicine name
config.medicineName.description: What the pet calls it in the reminder bubble.
config.doseTimes.label: Dose times
config.doseTimes.description: Daily times separated by commas, for example 08:00, 13:00, 20:00 (up to 6).
config.snoozeMinutes.label: Snooze
config.snoozeMinutes.description: How long to wait before reminding again.
config.customSound.label: Custom sound
config.customSound.description: Optional sound to play with the reminder.
command.testReminder.title: Test reminder
command.testReminder.description: Show a medicine reminder now so you can check the message and sound.
command.takenNow.title: I took my medicine
command.takenNow.description: Mark the current dose as taken.
command.showToday.title: Today's doses
command.showToday.description: Show today's dose times and which ones are done.
bubble.missed: Did you take {name} at {time}? It looks like it was missed.
speech.taken: Great job! I'll remind you at the next dose.
speech.noTimes: No dose times set yet. Add them in the plugin settings.
